notes.title: Update v0.3.0a
notes.content:
patch notes:

- added juicy death / damaged effects for Reddz
- modified per-round Redd stat increase (number of kills, speed, etc)
- rewrote spawning system in preparation for the "AI Overhaul" update
- made the first industrial district gate cheaper
- updated audio menu sliders to have better user interaction / feedback
- fixed a bug in the game over menu that prevented mouse clicks

notes.title: v0.2.0a - In-Game Audio/Controls Menus + Small Audio Changes
notes.content: Added basic controls / options menu that are accessible from the in-game pause menu.

notes.title: Update v0.1.2a - Music!
notes.content: Added some in-game music tracks to keep your ears as busy as your fingers!

notes.title: Alpha Playtest #1 Has Begun!
notes.content:
The playtest is here! This is an opportunity to see a very early version of Top Down Zombies, and to help shape its future with your feedback. 

Over the next two weeks, we will be rolling out more features incrementally and even making some updates based on player input.

Stay tuned for more!
